facts.fact: The Open Government Partnership commitment page says Morocco set up the open data platform data.gov.ma in 2011, a pioneer, though its use remains very limited.

The commitment sets as baseline, doubling by 2020, 10 institutions adhering to open data and 100 datasets published on data.gov.ma; the baseline is dated to the start of the commitment period (August 2018), the page giving no other date.
